subjects.description: Metal and plastic parts ({parts}) on a fixture table inside a robot machine tending cell
subjects.appearance_details: Real parts with varied finishes: bead-blasted aluminium, polished steel with strong reflections, dark coated parts, slight dust and wear
subjects.relationship: Parts staged for a robot to load into a machine
subjects.pose: Resting on the table in stable positions
subjects.action: Static, nothing moves except the camera

background_setting: Inside a fenced robot cell: a dark steel fixture table with bolt holes and scratches, mesh safety fence, machine enclosure panels and a light curtain post in the background

lighting.conditions: Dimmer, warmer light from one strong lamp inside the cell plus weak ambient hall light
lighting.shadows: Harder, longer shadows and strong highlights on shiny metal

aesthetics.composition: Functional view of the table with every part visible
aesthetics.color_scheme: Dark steel, warm highlights, muted colors

cinematography.camera_motion: Slow, smooth handheld-free camera move around the bench, like an industrial camera on a slowly moving robot arm
cinematography.framing: Close to medium shot of the bench top with all parts in frame
cinematography.camera_angle: High angle looking down at the bench
cinematography.depth_of_field: Deep focus, all parts sharp as with a machine-vision camera
cinematography.lens_focal_length: Machine-vision lens, natural perspective, slight vignetting

style_medium: Raw footage from a real industrial camera, unedited, no color grading
artistic_style: Photorealistic, authentic real-world recording with visible sensor noise in the darker areas
context: Footage from a robotic machine tending cell during a late shift
